title: Grounding measurement report
description: Produced by SP-1, consumed by SP-4 (which screen regions the Eyes misread, so the profile can target them) and by SP-5 (which channel to use per step). The report is the feature's evidence: it says how often the Eyes actually hit each kind of target on real editor frames, so no later step has to argue from intuition.

frames.description: Repo-relative paths of the lesson screenshots that were measured.

ground_model.description: The model the Eyes used for locate(), recorded so a later model change invalidates the number rather than silently inheriting it.

probes.description: One entry per probe kind. All three kinds are required: a report missing one cannot answer which parts of the editor vision is good for.

rate.description: hits / attempts. A hit means the returned point falls inside the hand-labelled target region, not that it is close to it.

median_error_px.description: Median distance from the returned point to the labelled region, across all attempts including misses.

verdict.description: One paragraph in channel terms: which steps SP-5 should attempt by vision and which by the API. It is a reading of the numbers, never a replacement for them.
